lines.say: Three things to do this week if you've got January exams.
One. Close the solution and explain the method out loud. If you can't explain it, you can't use it.
Two. Mix your topics. The exam won't tell you which method it wants.
Three. Go back to the topic you did first. That's the one you've forgotten.
Offload does number one for you. It makes you explain each method in your own words, from your own notes.
Number three, honestly, is the one nobody does.
